name: Yuezhuo: Moye zhi Sha
source: There was a murder incident in the school. In order to solve it and avoid unnecessary social influence, the police dispatched a small group of professionals to conduct an undercover investigation. The group included Ji Yujing, who had just returned from studying abroad, and her mentor. After tough investigations, they found that things were far more complicated than they expected. They finally found a key witness, but what followed was an unexpected situation...
translation: 学校里发生了一起杀人事件。为了解决此事，避免造成不必要的社会影响，警方派出一小批专业人士进行卧底调查。这群人中有刚留学归来的季玉静和她的导师。经过艰苦的调查，他们发现事情远比他们想象的复杂。他们终于找到了关键证人，但接下来的却是意想不到的情况……
